title: Audit: Find localStorage keys that leak between users
description: Search codebase for localStorage/sessionStorage usage that could cause data to persist or leak between different authenticated users on the same browser.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Grep for all localStorage.setItem and localStorage.getItem calls
List all localStorage keys used in the app
Identify which keys should be cleared on logout
Check if logout clears user-specific localStorage

notes: CODE REVIEW ONLY - DO NOT USE BROWSER. Use grep/read tools only. Known keys: songscript_visitor_id, songscript_welcome_shown. Look for any others that could leak user data.
